dex.entry: A matchstick sprite, barely the height of a thumb, that ignites itself to draw attention away from endangered kin, then safely regrows its wax body overnight. It sacrifices its own flame to protect others — children love a scrappy little helper with a big heart.

art.silhouette: Thin matchstick body of pale cream wax, a spherical amber head topped by a single tiny flame-tuft; two twig-thin arms; big worried eyes; small enough to balance on a coin at 16px.
